title: The displacement bar scales with registry maturity: a Republic, not a fortress
subject: displacement-bar-maturity
ratio: PR-019's embed requirement gains a maturity axis: before Phase B activates, the reasoning burden for displacing an incumbent rule must be calibrated against registry maturity, so that entry never becomes harder merely because the registry grew. The calibration - the maturity measure and its thresholds - is fixed at Phase B design time through the overruling-grade protocol. Until calibrated, the current fixed bar stands as a floor that is explicitly provisional on this axis.
dicta: Operator ruling 3, 2026-08-13, wording preserved: es un sistema evolutivo como toda Republica. Enacts the escalated contradiction 1 of the R1 validation memo (AAH2013 Prediction 3: a fixed-form entry barrier grows more damaging as the registry matures - exactly when Phase B would activate). The join's finding that PR-019's revisit_trigger had no maturity axis is hereby cured: this record IS that axis's anchor.
scope_conditions: the displacement-bridge enforcement in precedent.py and any future recalibration of its reasoning burden
revisit_trigger: Revisit at Phase B design time, when the maturity measure and thresholds must be fixed through the overruling-grade protocol.
validity_conditions: PR-019 active with its prospective embed rule; Phase B not yet designed
